description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the CustomerService component within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It contains unit tests for methods like saveCustomer, searchCustomers, and getCustomer by ID, utilizing mock objects and test data setup.

classes.name: CustomerServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for CustomerService, testing customer persistence and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of CustomerService, and loads test fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveCustomer
methods.description: Tests the saveCustomer method of CustomerDao using a mocked DAO, verifying it returns the saved customer.

methods.name: testGetAllCustomer
methods.description: Tests the searchCustomers method of CustomerService, asserting it retrieves the correct list of Customer objects.

methods.name: testGetCustomerById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Customer by ID, verifying the correct Customer object is returned.
